tooltip.scythes.blood_blender.desc: Right click in the air pulls enemy targets within ${balance:Blood.BLENDER_RADIUS|number} blocks toward you, deals damage equal to ${balance:Blood.BLENDER_HIT_COUNT|number} basic scythe attacks, inflicts Slowness ${balance:Blood.BLENDER_SLOWNESS_AMPLIFIER|amplifier} for ${balance:Blood.BLENDER_SLOWNESS_TICKS|seconds} seconds, and inflicts Bleeding ${balance:Blood.BLENDER_BLEEDING_AMPLIFIER|amplifier} for ${balance:Blood.BLENDER_BLEEDING_TICKS|seconds} seconds. Ignores teammates, pets, and neutral mobs. If there are no nearby targets, the ability does not activate.
tooltip.scythes.blood_harvest.desc: Marks enemy players within ${balance:BloodHarvest.RADIUS|number} blocks for ${balance:BloodHarvest.KILL_WINDOW_TICKS|seconds} seconds. Costs ${balance:BloodHarvest.DURABILITY_COST|number} durability and has a ${balance:BloodHarvest.COOLDOWN_TICKS|seconds}-second cooldown. Kill during the window for ${balance:BloodHarvest.SUCCESS_BUFF_TICKS|seconds} seconds of Speed ${balance:BloodHarvest.SUCCESS_SPEED_AMPLIFIER|amplifier}, Strength ${balance:BloodHarvest.SUCCESS_STRENGTH_AMPLIFIER|amplifier}, and Regeneration ${balance:BloodHarvest.SUCCESS_REGEN_AMPLIFIER|amplifier}; fail and receive ${balance:BloodHarvest.FAILURE_DEBUFF_TICKS|seconds} seconds of Slowness ${balance:BloodHarvest.FAILURE_SLOWNESS_AMPLIFIER|amplifier}, Weakness ${balance:BloodHarvest.FAILURE_WEAKNESS_AMPLIFIER|amplifier}, and Blindness.
tooltip.scythes.bloody_scythe.desc: A cursed endgame scythe for relentless melee pressure: ${balance:Blood.BLEEDING_CHANCE|percent}% bleed chance, ${balance:Vampirism.VAMPIRISM_CHANCE|percent}% vampirism chance, a ${balance:Blood.DEFENSE_PIERCE_CHANCE|percent}% chance to partially pierce defenses, and Blood Harvest for finishing marked players.
tooltip.scythes.bloody_scythe.passive.de: On hit: ${balance:Blood.BLEEDING_CHANCE|percent}% chance to inflict Bleeding for at least ${balance:Blood.BLEEDING_BASE_DURATION_TICKS|seconds} seconds. Bleeding deals true damage and ignores armor, Protection, and resistance. Vampirism has a ${balance:Vampirism.VAMPIRISM_CHANCE|percent}% chance to heal ${balance:Vampirism.HEAL_FRACTION|percent}% of actual damage dealt, with a ${balance:Vampirism.COOLDOWN_TICKS|seconds}-second delay between successful heals. It also has a ${balance:Blood.DEFENSE_PIERCE_CHANCE|percent}% chance to ignore ${balance:Blood.DEFENSE_PIERCE_MITIGATION_IGNORED|percent}% of the target's damage mitigation.
tooltip.scythes.frozen_scythe.base_stats: Base stats: same damage tier and attack speed as the other endgame scythes.
tooltip.scythes.frozen_scythe.desc: A frost scythe that commands ice. It lets its wielder traverse powder snow, freeze water, strike enemies with ice spikes, and summon a freezing storm.
tooltip.scythes.frozen_scythe.passive.de: While the Frost Scythe is anywhere in the inventory, its owner can walk on powder snow. While held in either hand, it freezes water like Frost Walker ${balance:Frozen.COLD_MASTER_FROST_WALKER_LEVEL|roman}. On hit, it has a ${balance:Frozen.COLD_MASTER_FREEZING_CHANCE|percent}% chance to apply Freezing for ${balance:Frozen.COLD_MASTER_FREEZING_TICKS|seconds} second.
tooltip.scythes.frozen_storm.desc: Summons a freezing storm in a ${balance:FrozenStorm.RADIUS|number}-block radius. Every valid target receives Freezing for ${balance:FrozenStorm.FREEZING_TICKS|seconds} seconds plus Slowness and Weakness for ${balance:FrozenStorm.SLOWNESS_TICKS|seconds} seconds. It costs ${balance:FrozenStorm.DURABILITY_COST|number} durability, has a ${balance:FrozenStorm.COOLDOWN_TICKS|seconds}-second cooldown, and does not affect pets or teammates.
tooltip.scythes.golden_rain.desc: The active ability costs ${balance:GoldenRain.DURABILITY_COST|number} durability and has a ${balance:GoldenRain.COOLDOWN_TICKS|minutes}-minute cooldown. It marks every valid target within ${balance:GoldenRain.RADIUS|number} blocks with gold; each mark adds +${balance:Golden.MARK_LOOTING_BONUS|number} Looting levels to that target's future drops for the mark owner.
tooltip.scythes.golden_scythe.base_stats: Base stats: same damage tier and attack speed as the other endgame scythes.
tooltip.scythes.golden_scythe.desc: A lavish reaper's scythe of fortune: improves Looting, pacifies piglins, punishes one target with Midas Touch, and covers enemies in golden marks for richer drops.
tooltip.scythes.golden_scythe.passive.de: While the Golden Scythe is held in either hand, it adds +${balance:Golden.PASSIVE_LOOTING_BONUS|number} Looting level and counts as a golden item for piglin neutrality. The bonus does not stack from multiple Golden Scythes.
tooltip.scythes.ice_spike.desc: Right click to fire an ice spike in the direction you are looking at the speed of a fully drawn arrow. On hit it deals ${balance:IceSpike.HIT_DAMAGE|number} damage and applies Freezing for ${balance:IceSpike.FREEZING_TICKS|seconds} seconds. The ability costs ${balance:Frozen.ICE_SPIKE_DURABILITY_COST|number} durability and has a ${balance:Frozen.ICE_SPIKE_COOLDOWN_TICKS|seconds}-second cooldown.
tooltip.scythes.midas_touch.desc: Right click a target within reach to spend ${balance:Golden.MIDAS_DURABILITY_COST|number} durability with a ${balance:Golden.MIDAS_COOLDOWN_TICKS|seconds}-second cooldown. The touch deals true damage equal to ${balance:Golden.MIDAS_DAMAGE_FRACTION|percent}% of the target's max health, minimum ${balance:Golden.MIDAS_MIN_DAMAGE|number} and maximum ${balance:Golden.MIDAS_MAX_DAMAGE|number}. The target receives a golden mark: if it dies from this hit or later by the mark owner, its loot is rolled with +${balance:Golden.MARK_LOOTING_BONUS|number} additional Looting levels.

tooltip.scythes.stat.no_golden_scythe_st: Multiple Golden Scythes do not stack the passive bonus
tooltip.scythes.stat.piglin_neutrality: Piglins are neutral while the scythe is held in either hand
tooltip.scythes.stat.powder_snow_walk: Allows walking on powder snow while the scythe is in the inventory
tooltip.scythes.toxic_aura.desc: Activates for ${balance:ToxicAura.DURATION_TICKS|seconds} seconds with a ${balance:ToxicAura.AURA_COOLDOWN_TICKS|seconds}-second cooldown and costs ${balance:ToxicAura.AURA_DURABILITY_COST|number} durability. Within ${balance:ToxicAura.RADIUS|number} blocks it refreshes Poison ${balance:ToxicAura.POISON_AMPLIFIER|amplifier} for ${balance:ToxicAura.POISON_TICKS|seconds} seconds, damages armor every tick, and can trigger armor-piercing damage or Nausea.
tooltip.scythes.toxic_orb.desc: Right click launches a toxic orb with a ${balance:Toxic.ORB_COOLDOWN_TICKS|seconds}-second cooldown. It costs ${balance:Toxic.ORB_DURABILITY_COST|number} durability, bursts in a ${balance:ToxicOrb.DAMAGE_RADIUS|number}-block radius, deals ${balance:ToxicOrb.PURE_DAMAGE|number} armor-piercing damage, inflicts Poison ${balance:ToxicOrb.POISON_AMPLIFIER|amplifier} for ${balance:ToxicOrb.POISON_TICKS|seconds} seconds, and deals ${balance:ToxicOrb.ARMOR_DAMAGE|number} durability damage to the whole armor set.
tooltip.scythes.toxic_scythe.base_stats: Base stats: same damage tier and attack speed as the Bloody Scythe.
tooltip.scythes.toxic_scythe.desc: A brutal anti-armor scythe: its basic attacks corrode equipment and spread Poison II, while its orb and aura punish clustered enemies.
tooltip.scythes.toxic_scythe.passive.des: On hit: ${balance:Toxic.PASSIVE_ARMOR_DAMAGE_CHANCE|percent}% chance to deal ${balance:Toxic.PASSIVE_ARMOR_DAMAGE|number} durability damage to the target's entire armor set, and ${balance:Toxic.PASSIVE_POISON_CHANCE|percent}% chance to inflict Poison ${balance:Toxic.PASSIVE_POISON_AMPLIFIER|amplifier} for ${balance:Toxic.PASSIVE_POISON_TICKS|seconds} seconds.
tooltip.scythes.withering_aura.desc: Activates for ${balance:WitheringAura.DURATION_TICKS|seconds} seconds with a ${balance:WitheringAura.AURA_COOLDOWN_TICKS|seconds}-second cooldown and costs ${balance:WitheringAura.AURA_DURABILITY_COST|number} durability. Within ${balance:WitheringAura.WITHER_RADIUS|number} blocks it refreshes Wither ${balance:WitheringAura.WITHER_AMPLIFIER|amplifier} for ${balance:WitheringAura.WITHER_TICKS|seconds} seconds, while your minions within ${balance:WitheringAura.MINION_BUFF_RADIUS|number} blocks receive refreshed Strength ${balance:WitheringAura.MINION_BUFF_AMPLIFIER|amplifier} and Speed ${balance:WitheringAura.MINION_BUFF_AMPLIFIER|amplifier} for ${balance:WitheringAura.MINION_BUFF_TICKS|seconds} seconds.
tooltip.scythes.withering_scythe.base_st: Base stats: same damage tier and attack speed as the Bloody and Toxic scythes.
tooltip.scythes.withering_scythe.desc: A necromantic endgame scythe: harvests souls from the fallen, spreads Wither II, summons wither-skeleton minions, and empowers them with a dark aura.
tooltip.scythes.withering_scythe.passive: On hit: ${balance:Withering.WITHER_CHANCE|percent}% chance to inflict Wither ${balance:Withering.WITHER_AMPLIFIER|amplifier} for ${balance:Withering.WITHER_TICKS|seconds} seconds. Killing a mob stores ${balance:Withering.SOULS_PER_MOB_KILL|number} soul; killing a player stores ${balance:Withering.SOULS_PER_PLAYER_KILL|number} souls.
